sources.title: grug-v1.1-qwen-3.8-27b-mtp API & Inference Endpoint | FriendliAI
sources.snippet: what change ... disagree rate go from 1-in-10 to 1-in-21. old grug v1 mtp sit at 89.3%. honest part: native head was already 90.0% before any training. grug not rescue broken head — grug sharpen already-good head. and gold top-1 go up too (85.5 -> 88.2), so head get genuinely better at real token, not just better at copying verifier mistake.
